'''2017 EGP Matt Thornton DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Thornton]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
